headline: Authors sue OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT trained on mass pirated content
body: OpenAI faces legal action from authors claiming ChatGPT's training data included concealed mass piracy of copyrighted works. This lawsuit carries direct implications for healthcare AI vendors and their clients who depend on large language models for clinical documentation, evidence synthesis, and decision support. Healthcare organizations deploying GPT-based tools may face compliance and liability questions if underlying training methods prove legally problematic. The outcome could reshape how healthcare AI companies approach model development and disclosure of training data sources.
